lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense matrix of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly horizontal rows posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like visual anchor system across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct light-to-dark vertical gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of low-resolution, high-luminance spots contained within the boundaries of the visible first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: A long, slender, bright-white feature trailing near the ventral-caudal region, consistent with a commensal organism.
